messages:
Priya (Finance): Heads up — looks like Q2 pricing experiment promo EXPQ2-PROMO got auto-applied to Acme Corp invoice INV-78329. It shouldn't have (customer is on Dedicated commit). ping @Liam @Ava
BillingBot: Automated action: promo EXPQ2-PROMO applied to INV-78329 by rule 'experiment-auto' (rule id: exp-2026-04).
Liam (Sales): on it. Was the experiment flag broad?
Priya (Finance): Yep, it rolled to a global cohort by mistake. We need to reverse the promo on this invoice and either roll it forward as a goodwill credit or issue a refund — depends on CS.
Ava (Customer Success): Reached out to Acme. Quick note from them: "Prefer you roll it into next month's invoice — keeps things simple for us." They want a short email confirming the adjustment.
Marco (Accounting): We can do a manual adjustment. Need explicit approval from finance lead to move the line item. Also need GL mapping for the promo.
Priya (Finance): Approving rollforward to next invoice as 'goodwill credit' since CS confirmed. Please use GL 5230-promo. Also add note: "promo misapplied due to experiment config exp-2026-04".
Marco (Accounting): Will create manual journal and adjustment. Drafting JN now.
Priya (Finance): Invoice snippet for reference:
```
INV-78329 (2026-04-18)
- Hosted API usage: $12,345.67
- Committed discount (dedicated): -$2,500.00
- Promo (EXPQ2-PROMO): -$1,000.00  <-- misapplied
Total due: $8,845.67
```
Marco (Accounting): Journal created: JN-4882. Manual adjustment entry: apply $1,000.00 goodwill credit to Acme account and post to GL 5230-promo. Will attach JN PDF to the account and link to next invoice (tentative INV-78383).
BillingBot: Manual adjustment queued by Marco (Accounting). Status: pending apply on next billing cycle.
Ava (Customer Success): I'll send the confirmation email to Acme now and attach the billing note. Template: "We've moved the $1,000 EXPQ2 promo to your May invoice (INV-78383) as a goodwill credit; original INV-78329 remains paid as adjusted."
Liam (Sales): Fine by me. Also flagging this for experiment owners — we should restrict experiment flags from reserved cohorts.
Priya (Finance): I'll open a ticket with product/experiments to tighten the rollout scope. Ticket: EXP-COHORT-623.
Marco (Accounting): Adjustment applied to Acme account and linked to INV-78383. Posted JN-4882 (ref: docs/accounts/JN-4882.pdf).
BillingBot: Adjustment applied — original INV-78329 left as-is with audit note.
Priya (Finance): Thanks all. Closing loop: rolled forward promo as goodwill, GL 5230 used, JN-4882 created, CS notified customer, ticket opened for experiment scope. Leaving note in billing-runbook and experiments doc. :white_check_mark:
